confirmedOriginalGaps: Coordinator nil transaction, unsubmitted phase, and same-process cached material returns occurred before the actual current Vault lease check.
A connected App session retained signing access if new material errors had no eligible remote recovery record or if a storage error was not a recovery whitelist member.
An old persisted signing status could still be returned after an access-invalidating failure when writing its replacement status failed.
implementation: The one Coordinator validates actual bounded Keychain publication/private key/certificate chain/modern profile CMS and expiry via Vault.lease before every observation early return; exact namespace/generation remains bound to the current journal.

The one Session stores only two validity dates from its actual verified connect profiles and checks them before foreground observation, detecting known connected-profile expiry even when replacement signing profiles are newer.

Any actual material observation failure immediately discards signing context before awaiting independent user-data comparison. Only the existing material-error whitelist may create an actual record-only recovery capability; typed storage/cancellation remains distinct.

Status returned after a failed replacement status write reflects retained access, never stale persisted signing access. It retains the prior timestamp and does not claim the new state was durably written.
The existing AppOwner becameActive to bootstrap to Session to Coordinator path remains the product entry; no UI, schedule, extra store, credential owner, network, upload or submit is introduced.

ownedTestBoundary.newInitializer: DEBUG-only root/currentApplicationRoot initializer on the existing AppOwner and Session; production initialization still uses Bundle.main.
ownedTestBoundary.proof: Owned application bytes pass the actual complete ApplicationMaterialVerifier, Vault.resume, current lease and identity checks. Configuration JSON cannot select a root or construct a proof.
ownedTestBoundary.prohibition: The owned root can only invoke the real limited material-validation path. Any phase requiring current-process observation throws ownedApplicationIsNotCurrentProcess; it cannot synthesize installed or process evidence.
ownedTestBoundary.fixtureIO: Only public owned Package fixture bytes copied using its actual bounded ZIP plan, followed by independent real complete material verification; dynamically generated real Keychain keys remain unexported.

newSDKDefinitions.note: Four App/debug-specific method bodies are active in the normal DEBUG test build; explicit loops do not add parameter leaves.

preparedOwnedCoverage: Real nil/candidateReady actor and journal observations reject an expired actual lease and retain exact original record bytes.
Real partial authenticated TLS upload plus actual Keychain revoke is detected in uploadIntent without new RPC; explicit unique recovery performs safe owned removal.

Actual App owner connects full owned material and a later-expiring replacement lease, then detects the original signed profile expiry after its application path has moved. Actual permission-denied status write also cannot retain stale signing access.

Actual App owner detects external same-namespace revocation, retains distinct material error and recovery-only status, and performs cleanup only through explicit recovery; no automatic Upgrade/Lookup/retirement follows.

Actual malformed owned Keychain UTF8 remains a typed storage error rather than a missing-material fallback. Self-cancelled pre-admission foreground leaves original configuration bytes and healthy connection unchanged.
A real authenticated submission receipt plus owned application root cannot produce current-process evidence or mutate the journal through the DEBUG seam.
remaining: This change is not SDK compilation or execution evidence. The six methods are definitions only until an actual same-source App SDK batch runs.

No authentic current-process synthetic-package proof is fabricated to exercise the cache hit. The guard ordering is independently source-reviewed; the DEBUG owned root explicitly refuses that process-proof branch.

Offline revalidation detects locally known signed validity dates, actual local Keychain missing/revoked/changed publication, and current offline chain/profile verification. It cannot discover a new server-side revocation without an authorized online channel.

The original connected application material is not wholly reread or continuously monitored on each foreground. Only its already-verified profile date bounds are retained; unrelated post-connect on-disk mutations and installed certificate-chain temporal changes are not newly revalidated by those two dates.

A failed foreground leaves explicit recovery available only when an actual eligible existing journal record permits it. Safe cleanup remains candidateReady in recovery-only mode and never authorizes retirement, new signing, Upload or Upgrade.
Status has no newly inferred Apple/account/device/install authorization, kernel image authenticity, cold-launch proof, complete data preservation, autonomous scheduling or automatic renewal success.

independentReviewFix.confirmedFinding: If material and normal-user-data observations both failed and the material-only recovery factory also failed, the factory catch discarded the independent normal-user-data error.
independentReviewFix.change: Only the Session recovery-factory catch changed. With a real normal-user-data error it now returns ObservationFailures containing that error and the original fallback error (which itself retains material and recovery-context failures); storage classification is computed from the actual fallback error.
independentReviewFix.note: No artificial proof/fake recovery or additional test-only owner is introduced merely to force this simultaneous-error branch; source narrow review is required.
